prompt.alinti: Want to run, chat GPT-like AI, generate images, and make videos locally for free?
It's a desktop app that does all the big AI tasks in one window.
You can chat with any local model that answers directly, generate images and video with a single click, and use a coding agent that edits your code and shows the diff first.
There's an agent mode that searches the web, reads files, runs commands, and even makes images, all through a permission gate you control.
You install it just like any other program, pick a model that fits your hardware from the built-in manager, and start typing.
It works with engines you already have like Alama or LM Studio, or it can set everything up for you automatically.
It's for anyone who wants a private, uncensored AI studio without paying for cloud subscriptions or using a terminal.
Come at Studio, and I'll send you the repo link.
